# Devon Bate

> music producer, composer, sound designer, and researcher. Montreal. I am open to freelance work: composition, sound design and audio post-production for film, music production, and presentations and workshops in sound studies.

Contact: [devon.t.bate@gmail.com](mailto:devon.t.bate@gmail.com); [Instagram @bufflo.prod](https://instagram.com/bufflo.prod).

## Pages

- [Work](https://www.devonbate.com/work/): every work, filterable by music production, film, podcast, theatre, dance, installation, composition
- [Research](https://www.devonbate.com/research/): My research sits at the intersections of sound, noise, technology, sleep and the environment. I have a Master's in Media Studies from Concordia University and began a PhD in Communication and Culture at York University in 2025.
- [About](https://www.devonbate.com/about/): I am a music producer, composer, sound designer and researcher in Montreal.
- [Contact](https://www.devonbate.com/contact/): email and Instagram

## Publications

- [One Thousand Days and Counting: A report on the social and health impacts of industrial noise from the Donkin Coal Mine in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia](https://cbu.scholaris.ca/items/0053252c-2232-4a6b-b2a6-6cb3d832bfb0): Sarah Barnes and Devon Bate. Cape Breton University, 20 April 2023. Report.
- [Orphic Media Practices and the Emptying of 'Content'](https://mediacommons.org/users/devon-bate): Devon Bate. In Media Res (MediaCommons), 10 October 2022. Author.
- [Digital Nocturnes: Sonic Sleep Media](https://mediacommons.org/users/devon-bate): In Media Res (MediaCommons), 10 to 16 October 2022. Curator.
